title: Set the startup disk
summary: Change the disk your Mac boots from. You must specify the path to the directory of the desired startup disk.

steps.explain: Set a new startup disk by specifying its path.

placeholders.name: STARTUP_DISK_PATH
placeholders.description: The path to the directory of the startup disk, e.g., /Volumes/Macintosh HD

rollback.explain: Set the startup disk back to the original volume if the new one fails to boot.

placeholders.name: ORIGINAL_DISK_PATH
placeholders.description: The path to the original startup disk directory

warnings: Setting an invalid startup disk may prevent your Mac from booting. Ensure the path is correct.
